name: Validate SFX Library
description: Pre-flight check: verifies the SFX library FAISS index exists and is searchable. Does NOT re-run the SFX profiling pipeline — that's a one-time setup. Fails with a clear message if the index is missing or corrupt.

inputs.name: sfx_library
inputs.description: Absolute path to the shared SFX library folder

outputs.name: sfx_library_status
outputs.description: Validation result: { valid: bool, profiles_count: int, index_searchable: bool }

preconditions: SFX library folder exists with profiles/ subdirectory
FAISS index has been built (run sfx_pipeline.py once to create)
